Delhi Health Official Arrested in Corruption Case; Heatwave and Monsoon Updates

Former Delhi Director General of Health Services Dr. Vatsala Agarwal has been arrested by Delhi Police in connection with alleged corruption in medical procurement. Meanwhile, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has indicated favorable conditions for the advance of the Southwest Monsoon, predicting rainfall in various northern and central regions. Delhi also experienced a severe heatwave with a 'feels like' temperature of 48.4°C, though rains are expected soon.
